messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — design review tomorrow 11am PT: finalize routing policies editor decisions. Primary topics: preview controls, rule ordering affordances, validation wording, and mobile a11y.

chris: For the preview, i'm leaning toward an inline "playback" beneath the rules list (keeps editor context). It should step through rule priority, not stream tokens. :eyes: 

sam: inline playback sounds good. proposal: show a compact timeline with ticks for each rule and a 'play/pause' control. each tick highlights the matched rule and shows matched fields. cheaper than streaming.

aleks: agree. visual idea: dim non-matching rules (ghosting) and put a left icon for the matched rule (bolt). must not use color alone.

leo: accessibility: the step change should announce via aria-live: "Step 2 of 5: Rule matched — route to dedicated". keyboard: left/right arrows step, Enter expands details.

tania: mobile UX: no hover, so drag handles won't work. fallback = action menu (⋮) per rule with Move up / Move down / Pin to top. Pin keeps rule visible for sim tests. limit to 1 pin per policy.

maya: agree on single-pin limit. add tooltip: "Pinned rules stay at top during simulation".

chris: reordering controls: implement both drag handles for power users and explicit up/down buttons for discoverability and a11y. when dragging announce position: "Moving rule to position 3."

sam: keyboard drag pattern ok (Space to pick, arrows to move, Space to drop). also add Move to Top/Bottom quick actions. i'll scope a spike.

aleks: validation copy: current badge says "Invalid". please replace with actionable copy. suggestions: 
- short: "Needs condition"
- actionable: "Rule inactive — add a match condition to enable."
- warn: "Potential overlap with rule 3"
Keep telemetry codes hidden (e.g., missing_match) but show human text to users.

leo: include an inline help link in the validation bubble: "Learn how to write conditions". for SR users, include a descriptive aria-label on that link.

chris: visuals: focus outline to brand-blue-600, matched state uses success-400 + icon + dashed underline to avoid color-only cues.

tania: on mobile, the three-dot menu should expose Move / Pin / Edit / Disable. make those targets >=44px.

maya: simulation timeline niceties: hover/tap ticks shows tooltip "Rule 4: matched (8ms)". also show small latency numbers to help debug Dedicated runs.

sam: test plan: i'll add Cypress + axe checks for keyboard reorder, live region announcements, and focus target sizes. estimate: 2 dev days for spike.

aleks: i'll push a Figma set: inline playback + full-modal alt, both with annotated keyboard states and mobile menu variants.

chris: microcopy: i'll include three wording variants per validation type (concise, actionable, technical) for PM selection.

ux-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled 2026-04-12 18:00 UTC. Figma link expected 2026-04-12 16:00 UTC.

maya: thanks team. decision checklist to confirm in the review: 1) inline compact playback with ghosting + tick timeline; 2) drag + up/down + keyboard move controls; 3) single-pin mobile fallback; 4) actionable validation copy + help link; 5) aria-live announcements and 44px touch targets. post Figma + acceptance criteria in this thread before the meeting.
